acceptance: An integration test injects a failing query into TPC-H and TPC-DS throughput on a real engine and asserts the failure propagates
An integration test proves throughput SQL is dialect-translated on a non-DuckDB engine
An integration test covers deferred close with a hung stream
Each test fails on develop 8ed0c64e1 before the corresponding fix
description:
tests/integration/test_throughput_real_duckdb.py is the only real-database throughput test. DuckDB accepts the untranslated SQL and never returns FAILED for these queries, so it cannot catch the TPC-DS false-success defect or the TPC-H dialect gap. The capability sweep test checks declarations only. No test covers the deferred close end to end. No real-server tests were found for the independent-connection overrides (not exhaustively checked).

TPC-DS throughput success, dialect translation, deferred close and per-stream session isolation each need at least one test against a real engine that rejects bad SQL or uses independent sessions (for example a file-backed SQLite once fixed, or the Docker PostgreSQL used by UAT).
